content: Refined Memory Layer. This layer maps the coarse memories to the refined memories. First we use knowledge aided self attention (introduced later) to fuse INLINEFORM0 into themselves, the outputs of which are represented as INLINEFORM1 . Then we process INLINEFORM2 with a BiLSTM, whose hidden state dimensionality is INLINEFORM3 . By concatenating the forward LSTM outputs and the backward LSTM outputs, we obtain the refined memories INLINEFORM4 , which are the final passage representations.
